claims.claim: All Hyundai and kia genuine spare parts and accessories are available both new and fairly used
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only a single headlight; no inventory, shop signage, or Hyundai/Kia branding is visible.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy
claims.evidence: Faint lettering on the lens cannot be read as Toyota or any brand in Photo 0.
Photo 0 shows a cloudy/oxidized lens but does not confirm the absence of cracks.
Mounting brackets and a wiring pigtail are visible underneath, but the completeness of all clips is not shown.

risks.risk: The headlight does not power on or the bulbs are burnt out.
risks.proof: A video clip of the unit connected to power with all lighting functions illuminated.

risks.risk: The fitment is unknown (wrong make, model, year, or side).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the part number, brand marking, or fitment label, plus a view showing left or right orientation.

risks.risk: Mounting clips or adjusters are broken or missing.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all mounting clips and adjusters from multiple angles.

risks.risk: Bulbs are not included with the unit.
risks.proof: A photo showing bulbs seated in the housings or included in the sale.

risks.risk: Lens oxidation is severe enough to reduce light output.
risks.proof: A close-up daylight photo of the lens surface showing the extent of haze.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any part number, brand marking, or fitment label.
Video of the headlight powered on showing all functions.
Close-up photos of mounting clips and adjusters.
Photo confirming whether bulbs are included.
Photo indicating whether it is a left or right side unit.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a used car headlight assembly, so it can be valued at its worst case (non-working, unknown fitment, no bulbs, unverified clips); clearer photos and a power-on video would raise the value.
